text: Write the smallest program that demonstrates the book's opening claim. Fill in the three blanks.
explanation: Verified: 200, -56, È, c8. One pattern, four readings, and the casts are not conversions in any meaningful sense — nothing about the bits changes. They are instructions about which agreement to apply when printing. Chapter 1 argued this on paper before Java had appeared; this is the same claim in four lines, and the book ends where it began.
